content.text:
Perfect! Created the text rendering module. All 56 tests pass ✅

**src/render.js** — `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`
- First line: Invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not yet issued)
- Second line: Customer name (or customer ID if lookup fails)
- One line per invoice item: qty, product name, unit price, line total
- Final line: Total amount
- **All amounts formatted through formatEuros()** for consistent customer-facing display

**Test coverage (7 tests)**:
- Draft vs. issued invoices
- Customer name lookup and fallback
- Euro formatting of all amounts
- Line item details
- Multiple line invoices
- Edge case: unknown customer ID

Example output:
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5 Development (hour) €95.00 €475.00
3 Design work (hour) €85.00 €255.00
Total: €730.00
```
